classification: world-model-only pilot; cannot replace V15.7 or support a Track2 success claim
hypothesis: A 13.14M-parameter one-pass multi-source flow U-Net initialized from V15.7 can absorb exact policy-state behavior from the frozen teacher while ground-truth motion/texture/structure losses prevent teacher-error amplification, providing a much faster parent candidate for later full training.

temporal_structure_corrections.first_transition_supervised: temporal delta includes context frame 5 to predicted frame 1, not only future-to-future transitions
temporal_structure_corrections.static_identity_scope: only pixels static throughout all eight ground-truth frames; excludes any pixel occupied by a moved gripper or bottle
temporal_structure_corrections.source_entropy_purpose: avoid soft averaging of slightly misaligned source glyphs and preserve arm lettering

data.teacher_arm_protocol: one task-level arm label per environment across all 13 cached chunks; 16 explicit-prompt labels plus 16 aggregate-motion labels, zero prompt conflicts

training.validation_protocol: 16 left-arm and 16 right-arm windows selected by deterministic linspace over the complete episode-disjoint validation path order, covering early through late horizons
